records.text: Alexandra (commenter; surname unverified) writes, “Thank you for your bravery, fearlessness, and faith. I started to listen to be able to debate the right. Years later, I am a superfan who never misses a show because you opened my eyes so much. Thank you from Portugal.” Oh, Portugal is on my list to visit. I was saying that to my husband. I would love to see Portugal. I have never been to Portugal. Thank you. I love hearing that.
